currentArchiveOrder: SELECTED -> all selected symbols marked used
QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED -> only sampled up to 6/pool marked used
NEAR_MISS -> only diagnostics top12, then sampled up to 6/pool marked used
REJECTED_AFTER_BASE -> only sampled up to 6/pool marked used
BROAD_CONTROL -> any feature row not in used and meeting history/price/primary-liquidity filters

structuralBug.rootCause: BROAD_CONTROL sampling is conditioned on prior bounded serialization through `used`: rows sampled into earlier cohorts are excluded, while semantically identical rows not sampled into those cohorts remain eligible.
consequences: BROAD_CONTROL is not an independent sample from the full broad eligible universe.
BROAD_CONTROL is not a clean mutually-exclusive residual population either, because unsampled qualified/near/rejected rows can enter.
Its latent mixture depends on earlier cohort caps and sampling outcomes.
Changing a prior cohort cap can change BROAD_CONTROL composition even if the underlying market population is unchanged.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.setup: 10 GENERAL rows pass scoreCandidate, 3 selected. QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED sampler keeps only 6 of remaining 7.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.consequence: The seventh true qualified row is not in used and can be selected into BROAD_CONTROL if it meets history/price/minLots filters.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.setup: 20 GENERAL basePassed=true rows fail the same downstream gate; old REJECTED_AFTER_BASE keeps only first 6.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.consequence: 14 unsampled rejected rows are not in used and can be hash-sampled into BROAD_CONTROL.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.setup: More setup-first-failure rows exist than diagnostics top12/per-pool archive limits.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.consequence: Rows not represented by nearSymbols/used can enter BROAD_CONTROL despite being technical near/setup rejects.

interpretationImpact: The current BROAD_CONTROL label is semantically ambiguous: it is a quota-conditioned residual mixture.
Selected-vs-BROAD_CONTROL contrasts may depend on arbitrary upstream Shadow sampling caps, not only market behavior.

A qualified/rejected row entering BROAD_CONTROL is not intrinsically wrong if the intended comparator is an independent broad-market sample; what is wrong is selectively excluding only the rows from that latent state that happened to be sampled earlier.
Current single primary cohort field does not preserve overlapping memberships, so a row cannot simultaneously be represented as e.g. QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED and BROAD_MARKET_CONTROL.

safeRepair.principle: Choose and freeze one control estimand instead of mixing two semantics.

optionA_independentBroadMarketControl.estimand: Random/deterministic outcome-free sample from a frozen broad eligible universe, independent of focal cohort sampling.
requirement: Sampling frame defined before SELECTED/QUALIFIED/NEAR/REJECTED sampling.
A symbol may have both a primary Formal-state label and broad-control membership.
Persist membership flags/array or separate control-membership table because (scan_date,symbol) single-cohort storage cannot represent overlap cleanly.
Do not remove a symbol from broad-control eligibility merely because it was sampled into another research cohort.
optionA_independentBroadMarketControl.preferredFor: Selection Alpha vs broad market baseline

optionB_mutuallyExclusiveResidualControl.estimand: Rows that are explicitly outside all focal semantic populations under a frozen rule.
requirement: Classify semantic state for every row first.
Exclude full populations, not sampled rows only.
Rename to RESIDUAL_CONTROL because it is not a broad-market sample.

safeRepair.forbiddenHybrid: Current pattern: exclude earlier sampled members but retain unsampled members of the same latent population.

falsification: Measure how much BROAD_CONTROL composition changes when only earlier Shadow sample caps are changed in a research replay; underlying feature universe and Formal decisions must stay fixed.
If composition/outcomes are stable to cap changes, practical distortion may be low even though semantics remain ambiguous.
If broad-market control is the intended estimand, compare an independently sampled membership overlay against the current quota-conditioned control on identical dates.
If residual control is intended, classify all PIT rows first and prove mutually-exclusive population counts.
Do not silently relabel historical rows; use a versioned quality/membership overlay.

governance.researchArchiveRepair: Potential Class A if only Shadow classification/sampling changes, no market calls, no Formal mutation, and frozen Formal outputs remain identical.
governance.historicalRepair: Append-only/versioned quality overlay; never mutate old snapshots to hide original capture.
governance.formalImpact: NONE unless someone later tries to use the research conclusion to change gates; such changes remain Class C.
